title: Microstructure Characterization: PMDCo (Simplified Input)
description: User-friendly form for a microstructure characterization session using optical microscopy, SEM, TEM, EBSD, or AFM. Records instrument metadata, imaging conditions, and quantitative microstructure metrics as a flexible results array. The transform converts this to full OO-LD (MeasurementDatum + ScalarValueSpecification nodes per PMDCo pattern).

experiment_name.title: Experiment Name
experiment_name.description: Human-readable name for this microstructure characterization session.

experiment_id.title: Experiment ID
experiment_id.description: Optional IRI slug for the RDF node. Auto-derived from experiment_name if omitted.

specimen_iri.title: Specimen IRI
specimen_iri.description: IRI of the specimen KItem being characterized (obi:has_specified_input).

test_date.title: Measurement Date
test_date.description: Date and time of the characterization session (ISO 8601).

magnification.title: Magnification
magnification.description: Nominal magnification used for image acquisition (e.g. 1000 for 1000×).

accelerating_voltage_kv.title: Accelerating Voltage (kV)
accelerating_voltage_kv.description: Electron beam accelerating voltage for SEM/TEM/EBSD. Omit for optical or AFM.

area_analysed_um2.title: Area Analysed (µm²)
area_analysed_um2.description: Total imaged or mapped area used for the statistical analysis.

etching_method.title: Etching / Preparation Method
etching_method.description: Surface preparation or etching technique applied before imaging.

software.title: Analysis Software
software.description: Software used for image analysis or diffraction pattern indexing.

results.title: Microstructure Results
results.description: Quantitative microstructure metrics. Add one entry per quantity. Each entry becomes a MeasurementDatum (IAO_0000109) with a ScalarValueSpecification (OBI_0001931) in the RDF graph.

name.title: Property Name
name.description: Microstructure quantity. Free text — any measurable property can be recorded.

value.title: Value
value.description: Numeric value of the microstructure quantity.
